_about: Move packages a Kivy transaction may call (audit V01, 2026-10-23). Seeded from every real Kivy transaction on chain; extended from data/unknown_pkgs.log after checking each package. The page refuses to sign a call to any other package. Keep in sync with KIVY_PKGS in index.html. 2026-10-26: Cetus + Bluefin 7k aggregator programs added for the backup swap routers (the owner: "A, add bluefin agg too"); each checked on chain (exists, modules match); oracle-priced pools left out. 2026-11-04: Bluefin 7k dropped as a router, its 20 route packages removed (the owner OK; review W1).
